# dreyv — Full Agent Context

> Non-custodial AI treasury workspace for Web3 teams. Solana-native. Intent → Plan → Simulate → Sign.

This file is the single-request, full-context document for AI agents and LLM crawlers.
For canonical site map and short overview, see `/llms.txt`. For machine-readable pricing, see `/pricing.md`.

---

## 1. Product overview

**dreyv** is a non-custodial AI treasury command layer for Solana DAOs, protocols, and Web3 teams.
Treasury teams normally juggle 8+ disconnected tools (wallets, DEX aggregators, analytics dashboards,
multisigs, chat, spreadsheets). dreyv replaces that fragmented workflow with a single workspace where
operators express intent in plain language and get an auditable, simulated, signable plan.

Pipeline:
1. **Intent** — operator types or speaks an intent (e.g. "rebalance 25% of USDC into mSOL over 5 days").
2. **Plan** — dreyv compiles the intent into a multi-step execution plan with route, fees, and risks.
3. **Simulate** — each plan runs against a forked state (Foresight Simulator) producing human-readable
   impact: balance deltas, slippage, MEV exposure, counterparty risk, and approver-friendly summaries.
4. **Sign** — the plan is proposed to the multisig (e.g. Squads). dreyv never custodies keys.

Operator surface:
- **CommandBar** — natural-language treasury control (Vercel AI SDK + Groq + Cloudflare Workers AI).
- **Foresight Simulator** — fork-based "what-if" with explainable outputs.
- **Solana Atlas** — public intelligence surface: token pages, MEV scanner, rug detector, DCA, holders.
- **dreyv Studio** — in-browser IDE + AI Architect for building treasury mini-apps and agents.
- **Marketplace** — publish/install treasury agents and mini-apps (Anchor program on devnet, 80/20 split).
- **Simulation Firewall** — blocks plans whose simulated outcome violates policy.
- **Persistent Knowledge Memory** — vector + GraphRAG memory across sessions and teammates.

## 2. Use cases

- **DAO treasury management** — propose, simulate, and execute multisig actions with human-readable diffs.
- **Non-custodial crypto treasury management platform** — keys stay in user wallets / Squads multisig.
- **Intent-driven DCA & rebalancing** — recurring buys, glide-path rebalances, with on-chain proof.
- **Multisig coordination** — Squads-native proposals with simulation attached.
- **Onchain research & due diligence** — Atlas tokens, rug-pull detector, MEV scanner, holder insights.
- **Yield routing** — Marinade, Jito, BlazeStake, Orca, Raydium with risk-scored comparisons.
- **Agent automation** — build and run treasury agents via Studio + Marketplace.

## 3. Key capabilities

| Capability | Description |
|---|---|
| Intent → Plan compiler | Plain-language → typed multi-step plan |
| Foresight simulation | Fork-based outcome preview, human-readable |
| Multisig-native | Squads (`@sqds/multisig`) proposals with attached sim |
| Non-custodial | No private-key custody; user/Squads wallets only |
| Solana Atlas | Public intelligence (MEV, rug, DCA, holders, tokens) |
| Studio + Architect | Browser IDE + AI to build mini-apps and agents |
| Marketplace | Publish/install agents (Anchor program, 80/20 split) |
| Knowledge Memory | Persistent vector + GraphRAG context |
| Simulation Firewall | Policy-gated execution |
| Agent-ready surface | `/.well-known/acp.json`, `/.well-known/ucp`, `/.well-known/ai-plugin.json`, `/.well-known/x402`, `/openapi.json`, `/llms.txt`, `/llms-full.txt` |

## 4. Constraints & trust model

- **Non-custodial:** dreyv never holds private keys. Signing happens in user wallets or Squads multisig.
- **Solana-first:** primary chain Solana mainnet; EVM read-only via wagmi/RainbowKit; Turnkey embedded
  wallets supported for in-app delegated signing only.
- **Simulation-first:** plans must pass Foresight + Simulation Firewall before being eligible to sign.
- **Open standards:** ACP (Agentic Commerce Protocol), UCP (Universal Commerce Protocol), MCP, x402.
- **Data residency:** Postgres on Neon; vector memory in pgvector; no PII sold to third parties.

## 5. Architecture

- Frontend: Next.js 15.5 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind, shadcn/ui.
- Backend: ~148 Next.js API routes under `/api/*` (treasury, simulation, swap, yield, atlas, studio, …).
- DB: Neon Postgres + Drizzle ORM (~30 tables in `src/db/schema.ts`).
- AI: Vercel AI SDK with Groq, OpenAI, and Cloudflare Workers AI providers.
- Wallets: Solana wallet adapter; Squads multisig; Turnkey embedded; RainbowKit/wagmi (EVM read).
- Realtime/collab: Liveblocks.
- Hosting: Vercel (production), Cloudflare for browser rendering and crawl tooling.

## 6. Pricing (summary — see `/pricing.md` for canonical machine-readable form)

- **Free** — $0/mo. 1 multisig vault, 2 teammates, 3 mini-apps, 10 agent runs/day, 60 API calls/hr, 1 GB.
- **Mini** — $49/mo. 5 vaults, 10 teammates/vault, more agent capacity, advanced simulation.
- **Max** — $199/mo. Unlimited vaults, priority models, dedicated firewall policies, SLA support.

Billed via Stripe (global cards) and Paystack (cards, mobile money, bank — Africa-first). Taxes shown at checkout.

## 7. MCP server (the headline integration)

Dreyv exposes the entire capability registry as a **Streamable HTTP MCP server** at `/api/mcp`. One
Bearer key, 100+ typed tools, simulation-first, non-custodial. Drop-in for Claude Desktop, Cursor,
Windsurf, Cline, Continue.dev, elizaOS, and any MCP-aware agent.

- Endpoint: `POST https://dreyv.com/api/mcp`  (Streamable HTTP per MCP 2025-06-18 spec)
- Discovery: `GET  https://dreyv.com/.well-known/mcp.json`
- Public manifest (no auth): `GET  https://dreyv.com/api/mcp/manifest`
- Docs + client snippets: https://dreyv.com/developers/mcp
- Key mint (prefix `dk_live_`): https://dreyv.com/app/settings/api

Required MCP request headers:
```
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json, text/event-stream
Authorization: Bearer dk_live_YOUR_KEY
```

Tool naming: REST capability `foo.bar` → MCP tool `dreyv_foo_bar`. Same scopes, same rate limits,
same metering across both transports — no drift.

## 8. REST API surface (canonical: `/openapi.json`, mirrored at `/api/mcp/manifest`)

Public/agent-relevant endpoint families (require auth via SIWS JWT or API key unless noted public):

- `GET  /api/health` — liveness (public)
- `GET  /api/price?token=SOL` — token price (public)
- `GET  /api/atlas/tokens` — token directory (public)
- `GET  /api/atlas/tokens/{symbol}` — token details (public)
- `GET  /api/mcp/manifest` — every MCP tool with input schemas (public)
- `/api/v1/identity/*`, `/api/v1/portfolio/*`, `/api/v1/treasury/*`
- `/api/v1/market/*`, `/api/v1/swap/*`, `/api/v1/bridge/*`, `/api/v1/gas/*`
- `/api/v1/risk/*`, `/api/v1/wallet/*`, `/api/v1/tax/*`, `/api/v1/foresight/*`
- `/api/v1/agentic/*`, `/api/v1/watchers/*`, `/api/v1/monitors/*`
- `/api/v1/economy/*` (x402, ACP, SKUs), `/api/v1/governance/*`, `/api/v1/defi/*`
- `/api/v1/knowledge/*`, `/api/v1/safety/*`, `/api/v1/compliance/*`
- `/api/v1/notifications/*`, `/api/v1/inbox/*`, `/api/v1/digests/*`, `/api/v1/webhooks/*`
- `/api/v1/audit/*`, `/api/v1/observability/*`, `/api/v1/billing/*`, `/api/v1/entitlements/*`
- `/api/v1/teams/*`, `/api/v1/privacy/*`, `/api/v1/storage/*`, `/api/v1/search/*`
- `/api/v1/status/*`, `/api/v1/jobs/*`, `/api/v1/exports/*`, `/api/v1/tags/*`, `/api/v1/flags/*`
- `/api/v1/insights/*`, `/api/v1/marketplace/*`, `/api/v1/sla/*`, `/api/v1/contracts/*`, `/api/v1/workflows/*`
- Legacy convenience: `POST /api/command`, `POST /api/planner`, `POST /api/simulate`, `POST /api/swap/*`,
  `GET /api/vault/balances`, `POST /api/squads/propose`, `POST /api/research`, `POST /api/tools/crawl`,
  `POST /api/tools/browser`, `GET /api/yield/opportunities`, `POST /api/dreyv-gateway/*`

Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <jwt|api_key>`. OAuth2 + API key flow documented at `/developers`.

## 9. Discovery & agent-ready endpoints

- `/.well-known/mcp.json` — MCP server discovery
- `/api/mcp/manifest` — full MCP tool catalog (public)
- `/.well-known/ai-plugin.json` — OpenAI plugin manifest
- `/.well-known/acp.json` — Agentic Commerce Protocol descriptor
- `/.well-known/ucp` — Universal Commerce Protocol profile
- `/.well-known/api-catalog` — RFC 9727 catalog
- `/.well-known/x402` — x402 payment capability (advertised)
- `/openapi.json` — OpenAPI 3.1 spec
- `/llms.txt` — short canonical context
- `/llms-full.txt` — this file (full single-request context)
- `/api/llms.txt`, `/developers/llms.txt` — scoped agent contexts
- `/pricing.md` — machine-readable pricing
- `/index.md` — markdown homepage fallback
- `/developers` — developer portal
- `/developers/mcp` — MCP setup + client snippets
- `/developers/api` — REST reference
- `/developers/agents` — agent integration matrix (Claude, Cursor, elizaOS, Continue, custom)
- `/developers/docs/[openapi|ai-plugin|acp|ucp|api-catalog|x402|llms-txt|llms-full|pricing-md]` — one page per spec
- `/compare` — competitive comparison
